dct_description_sm: This polygon data layer is the 2022 historical snapshot of City of Milwaukee tax parcels. Starting in 2009, each tax key, including every condominium unit, has a record. The portal identifies snapshots from December 2011 onward as end-of-year snapshots. The source shapefile is projected in NAD27 / Wisconsin South (EPSG:32054).
Original source: City of Milwaukee Open Data Portal.
